inventory_boundary.source_ref: raw/paper.pdf (12 pages; main text and Appendices A-D)
inventory_boundary.reason: The complete PDF and embedded appendices were audited through the end of Appendix D.

acceptance_criteria: All 21 cutoff/seed conditions are hash-attested and resume from 50-step atomic checkpoints.
The photon-number-sector implementation agrees with an independent dense Kronecker implementation at small cutoff.
Cutoff 32 retains at least 97 percent of the two-mode input probability and adjacent high-cutoff probability maps converge within the declared tolerance.
Any mismatch remains inconclusive because the paper omits the exact training instance and optimization contract.
Single-mode ranks match the Vandermonde prediction for distinct physical phases.
Explicit tensor-Fock and analytic Gram matrices converge and remain full rank.
Every binary labeling on the declared finite set is interpolated within tolerance.
Periodic-domain and Proposition 1 counterexamples are recorded without author code, arrays or source pixels.
